surfaces.reconciliation: Contract changes require a dedicated reviewed PR; no running loop edits its own active contract.
Schema changes require a dedicated reviewed automation transaction and must preserve accepted historical replay.
The repository bootloader surface is human-owned research-organization code; running loops may not rewrite the prompt that instantiates them.
The manifest declares desired external scheduler state. Audit reports drift and Monthly may propose changes, but changing the external research organization requires explicit human authority.
Each loop creates a unique immutable file with exclusive-create semantics; corrections are new linked receipts. V2 provenance-only corrections do not grant a second scientific implementation attempt.
Monthly governance publishes bounded delegation envelopes. Explicit human instruction may bootstrap or override an envelope. Triage may consume but never widen it.

Triage may create immutable bounded authorizations only inside the current delegation envelope. Daily consumes them directly; monthly may review, narrow, revoke prospectively, or supersede through a new envelope.

Daily may update its owned PR record. Triage may perform only mechanically verifiable lifecycle synchronization from live GitHub state. Monthly resolves cross-PR conflicts, stale work, splits, supersession, abandonment, and ambiguous ownership.
Monthly governance publishes the canonical move; triage may not rewrite it. Explicit human instructions may override it.
Legacy history is preserved but no longer receives mandatory scheduled appends; generated reports derive from immutable receipts.
Evidence events are immutable and cluster by underlying claim; source corrections create new events.
Raw belief events are immutable proposals with normalized scales and evidence provenance.
Monthly governance regenerates the consolidated view from immutable belief events. Triage has no belief-write authority.
Roundups are dated human-readable views; raw event files are canonical for machine reconciliation.
One accepted monthly synthesis governs queue-wide decisions for its period. Triage reads but never rewrites constitutional state.

Monthly governance owns accepted graph topology. Weekly may propose typed dependency/lineage edges; triage may only derive the ready frontier and route within already-active delegated quests. Explicit human transactions may bootstrap graph law.
Weekly and daily emit proposals; triage may classify proposals but does not rewrite quest-action history. Monthly records queue-wide acceptance, rejection, or deferral.
Monthly governance owns queue membership and ordering. Triage may authorize only bounded refinements inside IDs already active and delegated.
Completion requires accepted evidence and cross-queue ID validation. Triage cannot move a quest between queues.
Proposed quests cannot reuse IDs from any queue and do not become active without monthly governance. Triage has no activation authority.
Blocked status preserves artifacts, blocker evidence, and a reactivation condition. Triage may not block or reactivate queue membership.
Only the Daily Research Operator inside an active quest acceptance slice may mutate scientific implementation surfaces. Triage may authorize scope but never write the science itself.
